description: Product wrapper around orangepro_prove: run trusted-local setup_commands in the source checkout, then the UNCHANGED dynamic targeted-proof oracle, then refresh the behavior report. Setup is non-secret repo prep only (build/install/shim); a setup failure returns unrunnable, does not run the oracle, and leaves the ledger untouched (never Proven). Public Proven still closes only through the unchanged certificate.

link_node_modules.description: Trusted-repo speed mode: symlink node_modules into temp copies.

method.description: Optional consistency check. If provided, must match the member derived from target_symbol.

replacement.description: TS/JS: inert sentinel body, e.g. 'return null;' or 'return {"ok":false};'. Must be JSON-only per the oracle (required for TS/JS targets). Go derives its own sentinel.

run_id.description: Optional caller-supplied run id. Defaults to a local monotonic id.

setup_commands.description: Trusted-local repo prep run in the source checkout before the oracle. Non-secret only (build/install/shim). First non-zero exit returns unrunnable.

command.description: Executable to run in the source checkout, e.g. 'npm'.

source.description: Source checkout containing the test and target files. Setup runs here. Defaults to workspace.

target_file.description: Optional consistency check. If provided, must match the file derived from target_symbol.

target_id.description: Optional graph target id that must resolve to exactly one hard-linked CodeSymbol.

target_symbol.description: Exact CodeSymbol external id, e.g. sym:src/service.ts#OrderService.createOrder. Preferred.

test_env.description: Explicit non-secret KEY=value env entries for the test run.

test_path.description: TS/JS: repo-relative test file to run (required for TS/JS targets).

test_run.description: Go: fully-anchored test name for `go test -run`, e.g. '^TestCompute$' (required for Go targets). Java: 'TestClass#testMethod', e.g. 'CalculatorTest#addsTwoNumbers' (required for Java targets).

workspace.description: Local workspace root. Defaults to the current directory.

name: orangepro_prove_loop
title: Setup, run dynamic proof, refresh report
